limitations: No classification of abstract curve automorphisms or complete nilpotent structure of the nonreduced projective stabilizer. Earlier equivalent results under different positive-characteristic parametrizations remain a bibliographic possibility.
scientific_integrity: Complete geometric projective stabilizer and its tangent dimension established by normalization and direct Lie calculation. Small finite-field verification is supportive, not a proof of the infinite statement. No independent validation is claimed.
title: Non-smooth projective stabilizers of Kollár's characteristic-two cusp curves
